drafts.subject: Re: Invoice #2214 discrepancy
drafts.message:
Hi Sarah,

Thanks for following up, and apologies for the delay. Here's where things stand:

1. Corrected invoice status: Our billing team has submitted the revised invoice #2214 reflecting the agreed-upon amount of $4,200 (down from $4,800). The correction is now in the queue for processing.

2. Timeline: The corrected invoice is expected to be issued and visible in your portal by end of day tomorrow (Wednesday).

3. Friday deadline: We understand your payment run closes Friday, so we've flagged this as a priority. If, for any reason, the corrected invoice does not appear in your portal by Thursday morning, please reach out and we will escalate immediately.

Sorry again for the inconvenience, and please let me know if you need anything else to confirm on your end.

Best,
Impact Team

drafts.subject: Re: Guest lecture on agentic programming?
drafts.message:
Dear Professor Alvarez,

Thank you for reaching out and for your interest in having the Jaseci team speak with your graduate seminar. We are delighted to hear that your students are already experimenting with Jaseci, and we would be happy to arrange a guest lecture on agentic programming.

Regarding the proposed dates, September 22 works well on our end. We can accommodate the 60-minute format within your 2–4pm Eastern seminar slot, and a remote presentation is perfectly fine on our side as well.

I will be delivering the lecture, and I plan to cover the foundations of agentic programming in Jaseci, including how to design, orchestrate, and deploy multi-agent systems. I am happy to tailor the content to your students' current level of experience with the framework, so please feel free to share any specific topics or areas of interest you would like emphasized. If it would be helpful, I can also reserve time at the end for Q&A or a brief live demo.

Please let me know if you have any preferences regarding the lecture format or specific subtopics, and I will prepare accordingly. I will also follow up closer to the date with any connection details or platform requirements.

Thank you again for the invitation. We look forward to engaging with your students.

Best regards,
Jaseci Team
impact@jaseci.org
